wikven-footer-source: Footer link to the project's source repository. $1 is the repository host name (e.g. GitHub, GitLab) or a bare domain.
wikven-footer-source-plain: Footer link to the project's source repository, used when no host can be derived from the URL.
wikven-about-intro: Opening sentence of the About page the build writes when the source provides none.
wikven-about-software: Lead-in to the software tables in the generated {{Wikven software}} template, which an About page transcludes.
wikven-skins: Heading of the sidebar section holding the export's other skins, used by skins that render their own sections in the page-tools menu. The section key is the message key.
wikven-skin: Label of the skin chooser wikven adds to Citizen's preferences panel, beside the theme and text size. Singular: it names one setting, not the list.
wikven-skin-description: Description under {{msg-mw|wikven-skin}}, in the style of Citizen's own preference descriptions (no full stop).
wikven-settings: Label of the link to the generated settings page, in Minerva's main menu, where the skin would otherwise link to Special:MobileOptions.
wikven-settings-intro: Opening sentence of the generated settings page, explaining that a static export keeps display choices in the reader's browser.
wikven-skins-description: Description under {{msg-mw|wikven-skins}} on the generated settings page.
